hook: Victor slides a photo across the counter and says, 'You buried the wrong sister.' (L003)
cliffhanger: Maya turns the photo over; the back reads 'DON'T TRUST HIM' in her own handwriting. (L016)
title: You Buried the Wrong Sister
why_it_works: Opens on the single most arresting line in the episode — a direct, impossible accusation that forces a stranger to stop scrolling. The clip then escalates cleanly: photo proof of the living twin with today's newspaper, Victor's cold threat ('She wants your life back'), Maya shattering a coffee pot in raw panic, the coffin/box revelation, the midnight pier meet-up, Victor's ambiguous exit, and finally the handwritten note that reframes everything. Every beat is visual, high-stakes, and comprehensible without prior context.
